# Agent marks (simple-icons)

The notification icons `app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_stat_agent_*.xml` are generated by
`scripts/generate_agent_icons.py` from [simple-icons](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons)
16.38.1. The SVG data is released under [CC0 1.0](https://github.com/simple-icons/simple-icons/blob/develop/LICENSE.md).

The marks themselves are trademarks of their owners (Anthropic, Anysphere, Google, Windsurf,
GitHub, Cline, Zed Industries, OpenCode, Warp, Mistral AI). Nod uses them only to show which agent
sent a notification and is not affiliated with or endorsed by them.
